description: This file defines the ProductDao interface, which declares data access methods for Product entities within the sales manager application. It includes methods for retrieving products based on locale, categories, store, tax class, SEO URL, and product code.

methods.name: getProductForLocale
methods.description: Retrieves a product by ID tailored to a specific locale and language.

methods.name: getProductsForLocale
methods.description: Fetches a list of products for a store and category IDs, filtered by language and locale.

methods.name: getProductsListByCategories
methods.description: Gets a list of products belonging to specified categories.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists products available in a store filtered by language and criteria.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists all products in a store.

methods.name: listByTaxClass
methods.description: Retrieves products associated with a specific tax class.

methods.name: getProductsListByCategories
methods.description: Fetches products belonging to specified categories with locale and language.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Gets a product by its SEO URL within a store and locale.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a product by its code and language.
